name: jezero_albedo
encoding: 8-bit; relative albedo = value/128 (128 = tile median); <=3 = no image
source: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE orthomosaic (JEZ_hirise_soc_006_orthoMosaic_25cm, first)
processing: block-averaged from 0.25 m, DTM-slope shading regressed out (log-linear Lambert), 400 m-scale brightness halved to suppress inter-image seams
